answer: In this PoA design, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than one-time gains. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagate support, but a freshly spawned sybil—whether named pearl, raven, or nebula—has near-zero eigenvector centrality and negligible incoming trust; it therefore cannot pass consensus before earning durable, corroborated interactions.
